name: Rod of Major Hexes
body:
Price 55,000 gp (grasping, interminable), 162,500 gp (voracious), 270,000 gp (potent), 377,500 gp (abrupt); Slot none CL 20th; Weight 5 lbs.; Aura overwhelming (no school)

DESCRIPTION

A rod of major hexes is identical to a rod of hexes of its same name, but affects both normal and major hexes (not grand hexes).

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 27,500 gp (grasping, interminable), 81,250 gp (voracious), 135,000 gp (potent), 188,750 gp (abrupt)

Craft Rod, appropriate feat (Reach Spell for grasping, Extend Spell for interminable, Split Hex for voracious, Maximize Spell for potent, Quicken Spells for abrupt); Special creator must possess the major hex class feature
